Pull request #214 re-running four verifiers of the integer-multiplication bounds project; it reports no new κ. Closed without merge on 2026-10-14.

An input defect in the TRICERATOPS runs of the eumemic exoplanet catalogue (TIC 160420269) was reported; the maintainer acknowledged it and corrected the catalogue (55 signals change tier). Reported publicly as GitHub comments on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-18.

Independent re-analysis of five signals from the eumemic exoplanet catalogue, and two blind recoveries (TIC 370612437, HIP 114417). The origin of these signals is unresolved and needs ground-based photometry. Unpublished; no claim of correction.

29 transit times predicted for TESS sectors 109-110, plus TOI-1452 b, frozen with timestamps (OpenTimestamps and FreeTSA) before the data. Sector 110 began on 2026-10-31 and a ground-based test of TOI-1452 b was planned for 2026-11-01; no outcome is recorded here yet. The predicted values are not part of this register.

Periods for five variables absent from VSX (lot 1). Three have no catalogued period or type (TIC 105616985, 243167163, 243167066; flagged variable from Gaia scatter by Maíz Apellániz et al. 2023; automated Green et al. 2023 fit at twice the period for TIC 243167066, not selected as a candidate) and two were reported before (TIC 436556517 at 0.44 d by Thiemann et al. 2021; TIC 402964191 scored but not selected by Green et al. 2023). A note for RNAAS is in preparation.

Lean 4 theorems RH_up_to_14 and RH_up_to_15 about zeros of ζ, without sorry. The proofs have not passed an automated check, and the upstream project files they rely on could not be re-read. Unverified; not announced as new.
A Lean 4 bridge to class_number_problem.variants.imaginary, with a toy sieve and a certificate for N = 1. Superseded by Murphy's complete proof; not announced as new.
No [n,3,n-3] code over GF(9) for n ≥ 18 (19 upper bounds). Submitted to codetables on 2026-10-19; the maintainer does not plan an update soon. A catch-up of upper bounds, not a record.

49 (target, p) cases of strongly regular graphs without an automorphism of order p; 48 of 49 are implied by Behbahani (2009), the remaining case (136,30,8,6), p = 29, is numerical and its novelty is not established.
No AlphaEvolve record beaten. An exact Heilbronn verifier was written; the AlphaEvolve configurations for n = 7 to 12 of its problem 60 (Heilbronn-type, in the cube) have no symmetry of the cube.
Barrier at one half: lemmas reviewed, no route to α > 1/2 found. One reviewer found 15 of 16 lemmas correct.
Partial reconstruction of a 1653 Thurloe cipher key (155 of 166 symbols). Numerical; independent review and prior-art search still to do.

Infinitesimal jamming, hence jamming, of the 40-point configurations Q5 and R5 in dimension 5: two independent exact engines and a Lean 4 formalization of infinitesimal jamming (checked by hand; an automated proof-checking pipeline never accepted it), timestamped on 2026-10-10. The same result was published by Self (arXiv:2609.12640, v3 of 2026-10-15). Not announced as new.

No improvement found: no configuration of 41 points, none with inner products in the searched ring (numerical), and the upper bound 43 was not reached by this work. The table now gives 40 ≤ τ5 ≤ 43 (read 2026-11-02), from other work.
